## Contribution status

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Pull requests are paused until the maintainer has verified and published the
> first release. Pre-release pull requests may be closed without review. Issues
> remain welcome.

After contributions open, complete every applicable item below.

## Change

Describe the user problem, the chosen solution, and the linked issue.

## Verification

- [ ] The change stays within the approved read-only observability scope.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Repository-native formatting, linting, type, unit, build, plugin
      validation, and relevant end-to-end checks pass.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is current.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes user-visible behavior.
- [ ] Fixtures, logs, screenshots, and commits contain no credentials, private
      hosts, personal data, or customer observability data.
- [ ] Compatibility changes are intentional and supported by test evidence.
- [ ] Breaking behavior is clearly identified with migration guidance.

## Evidence

List the commands run and summarize their results. Use synthetic data in any
screenshots or recordings.
